entities.summary: Thomas Leeb (b. 1977-09-14, Klagenfurt am Wörthersee) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee and Austria. Known in the fields of austria, composers & musicians, europe.
